subject: Mt5ArchBridge.mq5 and the Wine IPC issue
body:
Hi Fredy,

I came across mt5-arch-integration and the note that mt5linux/RPyC often hits IPC timeouts under Wine 11, which is why you went with the Mt5ArchBridge.mq5 file bridge.

body:
Hi James,

subject: Live execution for walk-forward validated strategies
body:
Hi Brady,

I came across @stratchai/backtest and the honest framing around look-ahead bias, fee modelling and in-sample fragility. The chronological 60/40 split per product and re-evaluating top-K winners out of sample is exactly the discipline most libraries skip.

I am a freelance trading bot developer. Once a strategy survives that kind of validation, the next risk is execution: slippage, fees and position limits on a live account. I build execution layers for crypto exchanges and MT5, plus risk guards that enforce daily loss and drawdown limits, so the live version stays close to what you validated.

Would it be useful if I sent over a short example of a live executor with the same fee assumptions as the backtest?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Trading Bot Developer

I came across the tickatlas SDK and the breadth of the API behind it: quotes, OHLC and ticks for forex and metals, 42 indicators, a screener, currency strength heatmaps and an economic calendar, with retries that honour Retry-After.

I am a freelance trading bot developer working in MQL4/MQL5 and with TradingView. Two things forex traders often ask for are a news filter that pauses an Expert Advisor around high impact events, and a currency strength view on their MT5 chart. Both could run on TickAtlas data. I can build those as MT5 tools for your customers or as reference integrations for your docs.

Would it be useful if I sent over a short example of an MT5 news filter reading your calendar endpoint?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Trading Bot Developer

subject: Pine v6 scripts that need to live on MT5
body:
Hi Jabez,

I came across your pinescript-v6 package, the chunked Pine v6 reference for LLM agents with an installer and MCP server. Tracking recent additions like request.footprint() and syminfo.isin keeps agents from writing outdated code.

I am a freelance trading bot developer working in Pine Script and MQL4/MQL5. People who write Pine with AI help often hit the same wall next: they want the strategy running on an MT5 account or a prop firm platform. I convert Pine strategies to MQL5 Expert Advisors and build TradingView alert to MT5 bridges, so I could be a useful contact for anyone in your audience with that need.

Would it be useful if I sent over a short example of a Pine strategy ported to MQL5?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Trading Bot Developer
